meaning: A strict class separation is a semantic theorem only when the extended class contains a concrete witness function that the baseline class cannot represent. Composition, orthogonality, recurrence, or universal approximation alone do not establish that witness.
strict_target: exists f : X -> Y. f in F_attn_haar and f notin F_base

existing_graph_support.role: closure of the preceding exact composition surfaces
computability-capacity boundary; not a neural-function-class separation

factor_recurrence_separation.role: shows that a finite observation/factor can recur while the exact underlying state remains nonrecurrent
factor_recurrence_separation.implication: It separates observation-level recurrence from state-level recurrence. It does not by itself show that attention or Haar represents a function outside a baseline neural class.

current_result.reason: The repository currently contains exact attention/Haar composition theorems and factor-recurrence separation, but no concrete F_attn_haar witness together with a proof that the witness is outside a precisely defined F_base.

promotion_condition: Promote to SEPARATED only after both inclusion and a concrete nonrepresentability proof are present on the canonical Agda surface and reachable by theorem_graph_search and theorem_monolith_egraph_sync.
